lines.intro: Help Noah load the ark! Tap two animals that match, and they’ll walk in together.
lines.win: You did it! Every animal is safe inside the ark.
lines.done: Every animal is safe inside the ark.

lines.intro: God told Abraham to count the stars! Tap each star to make it shine, and let’s count them together.
lines.win: You counted ten stars! And God’s promise to Abraham was even bigger than the sky.
lines.done: God’s promise to Abraham was even bigger than the sky.

lines.intro: Jonah is deep down in the sea! Pop the bubbles as they float up, and let’s count them.
lines.win: Ten bubbles! And God sent a great big fish to save Jonah.
lines.done: And God sent a great big fish to save Jonah.

lines.intro: The shepherds’ little lambs are hiding in the fields! Can you find all ten?
lines.win: You found every lamb! Now the shepherds can hurry to see baby Jesus.
lines.done: Now the shepherds can hurry to see baby Jesus.
